answer: An agent marketplace selling walnut crop forecasts, trellis designs, and delta hedging services can require each active seller identity to lock a fixed bond for 90 days before accepting jobs. Creating more names does not bypass the bond: each must fund its own deposit and wait. An attacker running 1,000 identities must immobilize 1,000 bonds, paying financing costs throughout the lockup; splitting one funded identity creates no extra selling capacity.
